fact: TACD CARTENA says the finance ministry mandated it, with AfDB support under PAMFP, to design an electronic public procurement system (e-GP), prepare a readiness report and a roadmap.

A law firm's article of 8 January 2026 says Law 11/2025 of 12 December 2025 brings in the GE Compras electronic procurement information system, which it says allows electronic submission and evaluation of bids, without stating that it is live.
